result.notes: Devin has a genuine $0 free product tier (devin.ai/pricing) and individual users can generate Personal Access Tokens (cog_ prefix, Bearer auth) for programmatic API access without needing org admin approval. However, the primary documented path (Service User API Keys) requires organization admin capability, and the API docs steer most customers toward Teams/Enterprise setup, so real-world usage often involves an org context. No OAuth is documented. Official MCP server (mcp.devin.ai) is Cognition-published and requires the same API key (service user key recommended; legacy apk_ keys unsupported). Endpoint count/breadth not disclosed in docs; Composio's third-party wrapper lists 22 tools but that reflects their integration, not the full API surface. Legacy apk_/apk_user_ key scheme also exists but is deprecated.
result.one_liner: Devin is Cognition's AI software engineering agent, controllable via a REST API and an official MCP server for programmatic session/playbook management.
